description: Convert text to spoken audio with a FreeTTS voice and return a download link to the MP3 (or WAV with a FreeTTS PRO key). Use it when the user wants text read aloud, narrated, or saved as an audio file. Without a FreeTTS key: standard voices, up to 2,000 characters a call, a short spoken "FreeTTS" tag at the end, file kept one hour. With a key: the account's plan (PRO: HD and Signature voices, no tag, 10,000 characters a call, files kept 30 days). For three or more separate clips on a FreeTTS PRO account (word lists, quiz lines, one file per sentence), call batch_text_to_speech once instead of this tool several times.

include_audio.description: Also return the audio bytes in the result (large). Default false; the link is enough for most clients.

language.description: Language of the text when no voice is given, like 'German' or 'pt-BR'.

rerender_of.description: Read the same words as an earlier result again, in another voice or speed: the audio link (or id) that result returned, from the last 24 hours. The text is then not needed.

text.description: The text to read. Plain text; SSML is not needed. Required unless rerender_of is given.

voice.description: A FreeTTS voice id from list_voices, like en-US-JennyNeural (a short name like 'Jenny' also works). If empty, a good standard voice for the language is chosen.

name: text_to_speech

file.description: The same audio as a file.

download_url.description: Where the file can be downloaded.

file_name.description: A name for the file, made from its first words.

title: Text to speech (FreeTTS)
